sahneler.metin: A passenger liner struck rocks at the entrance to San Francisco Bay.
It sank in minutes, killing one hundred twenty eight people.
Thick fog covered the Golden Gate.
The crew struggled to organize the evacuation.
Navigation aids at the Golden Gate were improved afterward.

aciklama:
City of Rio de Janeiro struck rocks at the entrance to San Francisco Bay. The cause: grounding in fog followed by rapid flooding and a chaotic evacuation.

#shorts #engineering #maritime
